title: Pavane pour une infante défunte
notes: Slow, stately piano pavane, later delicately orchestrated; tender evocation, not a lament.

title: Daphnis et Chloé
notes: Vast choreographic symphony with wordless chorus: luminous dawn, pirates, whirling 5/4 finale.

title: Boléro
notes: One unchanging melody over a snare ostinato, building to a single orchestral crescendo.
